lines.text: In the twelfth year, God tells Ezekiel to wail for the multitudes of Egypt.
Egypt is told to go down and be placed with the uncircumcised, and mighty chiefs speak from Sheol.
Assyria and Moab are in the Pit with their graves all around them, slain by the sword.
Edom and the Sidonians lie slain, and Pharaoh sees them and is terrified.
God says He will spread His terror in the land of the living, and Pharaoh will be laid among the uncircumcised.
